name: career-proof
description: Career Proof: academic and career pathway platform (Uganda pilot)

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.ingest:ashe: python -I scripts/ingest/ons_ashe_build.py "data-raw/ons-ashe/x/PROV - Occupation  SOC20 (4) Table 14.7a   Annual pay - Gross 2026.xlsx" data-raw/ons-ashe/soc/soc2020volume2thecodingindexexcel20260827v3.xlsx "2026 provisional" packages/reference-data/src/snapshots/ons-ashe-uk.json
scripts.ingest:ke-wages: pdftotext -table data-raw/kenya-pay/ln108-2026.pdf data-raw/kenya-pay/ln108-table.txt && python -I scripts/ingest/ke_wages_build.py data-raw/kenya-pay/ln108-table.txt packages/reference-data/src/ke-minimum-wages.json
scripts.ingest:wbg: pdftotext -table -enc UTF-8 data-raw/wbg-pay/fy27-wbg-salary-scales.pdf data-raw/wbg-pay/wbg-table.txt && node scripts/ingest/wbg_scales_build.mjs data-raw/wbg-pay/wbg-table.txt packages/reference-data/src/snapshots/wbg-salary-scales.json
scripts.ingest:isced: node scripts/ingest/isced_names.mjs data-raw/isced/files.txt data-raw/isced/names.json && python -I scripts/ingest/isced_build.py data-raw/isced/files data-raw/isced/names.json packages/reference-data/src/snapshots/isced-mappings.json
